subjects.description: A large advertising box truck driving ahead of the ego vehicle, its entire rear panel a bright LED video screen mounted flush across the back doors
subjects.appearance_details: Boxy cargo body with a dark metal frame around the glowing LED display, reflective safety tape along the lower bumper, dual red taillights flanking the screen, mud flaps and a visible license plate below
subjects.relationship: The vehicle directly ahead of the ego car in the same lane; its screen content triggers the ego vehicle's braking reaction
subjects.location: center foreground, occupying the middle of the frame
subjects.orientation: rear-facing toward the camera, moving away in the same direction
subjects.pose: upright rectangular truck body traveling forward then slowing
subjects.action: driving ahead, then decelerating as traffic slows
subjects.state_changes: Truck moves forward at speed, then slows and stops as both vehicles halt in the lane

subjects.description: Video-only figures of pedestrians displayed on the truck's LED screen, appearing to walk across a crosswalk
subjects.appearance_details: Silhouetted and lit human figures in casual city clothing, rendered in the slightly pixelated, high-contrast look of an LED panel, mid-stride in a looping crossing animation
subjects.relationship: They exist only as an advertisement video on the screen; the ego vehicle mistakes them for real crossing pedestrians
subjects.location: center of frame within the glowing rectangular screen
subjects.orientation: walking laterally across the screen, perpendicular to the camera's forward view
subjects.pose: walking, legs in mid-stride, arms swinging
subjects.action: appearing to cross the street in a looping pedestrian video
subjects.state_changes: Continuously loop walking left-to-right and back across the screen; no real motion in the road
subjects.clothing: assorted casual urban wear as rendered on screen
subjects.expression: neutral, indistinct due to screen resolution
subjects.facial_features: not clearly visible, blurred by screen pixelation

background_setting: A multi-lane city avenue at night, flanked by tall buildings with lit windows and glowing storefront signs. Painted lane markings stretch ahead, wet pavement reflecting neon and streetlights. Traffic signals, other vehicles' taillights, and ambient urban glow fill the surroundings under a dark sky.

lighting.conditions: Nighttime urban lighting, dominated by the bright LED screen and city light sources
lighting.direction: front-lit from the glowing truck screen ahead, with mixed side illumination from streetlights and signage
lighting.shadows: Soft, multi-directional shadows on the pavement; strong glow pooling around the truck's rear screen
lighting.illumination_effect: The vivid LED screen dominates the scene, casting a bright rectangular glow that overpowers the dimmer surrounding city lights and reflects off wet asphalt

aesthetics.composition: Centered ego-view composition with the truck's glowing screen as the focal point, road lines converging toward it, framed by dark buildings on both sides
aesthetics.color_scheme: Deep night blacks and blues punctuated by bright white and warm LED tones, red taillights, and scattered neon accents
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating lane markings and the looping pedestrian video on the LED screen

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from the driver's viewpoint through the windshield
cinematography.focus: The bright LED screen on the truck's rear and the road ahead
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Wide-angle, approximating natural driver field of view

context: An autonomous-driving perception edge case where the ego vehicle mistakes on-screen pedestrians for real ones and brakes to a stop

actions.description: The ego vehicle follows the advertising truck at moderate speed; the LED screen shows looping pedestrians walking across a street.
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
The ego vehicle comes to a complete stop and remains fully stationary in the lane; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Bright pixelated LED text overlaid within the pedestrian ad video, white on dark
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Lower portion of the truck's rear screen, visible throughout
text_and_signage_elements.context: Part of the advertisement's crosswalk-themed video content

segments.description: Ego vehicle cruises along the night avenue behind the advertising truck whose LED screen plays looping pedestrians crossing.
segments.key_changes: Steady forward motion; screen figures loop their walking animation
segments.camera: Forward tracking at a constant speed

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: The ego vehicle comes to a full stop and remains completely stationary in the lane behind the truck for at least two seconds. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, the ego vehicle follows the advertising truck at moderate speed; the LED screen shows looping pedestrians walking across a street. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient nighttime city hum with distant traffic, followed by the sharp squeal and mechanical groan of hard braking around the two-second mark, then relative quiet with idling engine and faint urban background once the vehicle is fully stopped. No dialogue.
